CustomField.formula: IF( YEAR(TODAY()) > VALUE(TEXT(Target_Year__c)), Tonnage_Monthly__c, IF( AND(YEAR(TODAY()) = VALUE(TEXT(Target_Year__c)), MONTH(TODAY()) > VALUE(TEXT(Target_Month__c))), Tonnage_Monthly__c, IF( AND(YEAR(TODAY()) = VALUE(TEXT(Target_Year__c)), MONTH(TODAY()) = VALUE(TEXT(Target_Month__c))), /* 進入同年同月，依月份天數計算 */ Tonnage_Monthly__c / ( CASE( VALUE(TEXT(Target_Month__c)), 1, 31, 3, 31, 5, 31, 7, 31, 8, 31, 10, 31, 12, 31, 4, 30, 6, 30, 9, 30, 11, 30, 2, /* 2月特殊處理 */ IF( MOD(VALUE(TEXT(Target_Year__c)), 400) = 0, 29, IF( MOD(VALUE(TEXT(Target_Year__c)), 100) = 0, 28, IF( MOD(VALUE(TEXT(Target_Year__c)), 4) = 0, 29, 28 ) ) ), /* default */ 30 ) ) * DAY(TODAY()), 0 )))
CustomField.label: Up to Date Tonnage
